在本周末西班牙大奖赛排位赛前接受天空体育 F1采访时，沃尔夫重申了他的信念，即安东内利使用中性胎而拉塞尔使用硬胎的事实完全证明了这一决定的合理性。

“我们做的绝对正确，”沃尔夫说。“他（拉塞尔）用的是硬胎。预计一停是更好的策略。”
“中性胎是一种妥协；我们不得不让基米使用中性胎，因为他起步时用的是硬胎。”
“绝无可能，显然有些沙发战士在看了网上其他材料后会发表评论……说他被惩罚了完全是胡说八道。”
基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔在意大利大奖赛领先位置上多次展开史诗般的队友对决。
拉塞尔赛季初是明显的冠军热门，但被安东内利超越，这位20岁的车手在他第二个F1赛季中戏剧性地超出了预期。
这位英国车手在蒙扎赛后支持梅赛德斯的决定，坚称安东内利的表现值得称赞。
沃尔夫承认赢得冠军需要“严厉的决定”，但坚称他的车队没有“隐藏议程或偏袒”。
“这是我们过去12年角色的一部分，管理好车库的两边，”沃尔夫说。“因为如果你在冠军争夺中，一个人赛后总会失望，另一个人则会高兴。”
乔治·拉塞尔解释为什么车队选择在虚拟安全车期间不让他进站，这可能让他失去了蒙扎的胜利。
“我认为只要你透明，没有隐藏议程或偏袒，那就是最好的管理方式。”
“但这并不意味着我们没有做出一些严厉的决定。我们在周日早上进行严肃的谈话——我们面临的各种情况是什么？在来自另一支车队的压力下，我们的一名车手落后于另一名且太慢，我们会在需要时交换车辆。”
“但这是你有时需要做出的决定，无论方向如何，无论谁在前。为了赢得冠军你需要做出的决定，但总是会保持平衡。”
“我们本可能看起来像白痴，像法拉利一样”
布伦德尔和罗斯伯格辩论汉密尔顿-勒克莱尔碰撞是谁的错。
法拉利在意大利大奖赛后与安东内利共同成为头条新闻，此前查尔斯·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿在第一圈发生事故，前者将队友推入砾石区，导致损失多个位置。
沃尔夫表示，这次冲突让法拉利看起来“像白痴”，但希望避免对对手过于苛刻，因为安东内利和拉塞尔也差点让梅赛德斯颜面扫地。
这位奥地利人说：“我现在可以表达我的观点，说在2号弯将队友推出去是不对的，但在比赛结束前三到四圈，他们之间发生了一些我们没预料到的可怕时刻，因为乔治的轮胎已经报废，而基米快了一秒。”
托托·沃尔夫对法拉利事件发表看法，该事件中查尔斯·勒克莱尔在意大利大奖赛中将刘易斯·汉密尔顿逼出赛道。
“我们预料到他们会像那样战斗，最终可能导致一辆车进入砾石区吗？”
“我们可能很快也会看起来像白痴，就像法拉利最终看起来那样，所以这是微妙的界限。”

Mercedes chief Toto Wolff has dismissed suggestions from "couch warriors" that the Silver Arrows failed to treat George Russell fairly during the Italian Grand Prix.
Russell was narrowly leading the race from his team-mate Kimi Antonelli when Mercedes took a decision to pit the Italian under a virtual safety car.

The call ultimately benefitted Antonelli as he used his fresh tyres to pull off a stunning victory having started from 19th on the grid, which increased Russell's deficit to the Italian at the top of the standings to 66 points.

Speaking to Sky Sports F1 ahead of qualifying at this weekend's Spanish Grand Prix, Wolff reiterated his belief that the fact Antonelli was running on a medium tyre and Russell a hard tyre completely justified the decision.
Highlights from the 2026 Italian Grand Prix.
"It's absolutely the right thing we did," Wolff said. "He (Russell) was on the hard. It was predicted to be a one-stop as the better strategy.
"The medium was a compromise; we had to put the medium on Kimi because he started on the hard.
"There is just no way, and obviously there are some couch warriors that will drop their comments after having watched some other material online… saying that he was penalised is complete bull****."
Kimi Antonelli and George Russell go wheel-to-wheel for the Italian Grand Prix lead in several epic team-mate battles.
Russell started the season as the clear title favourite but has been outperformed by Antonelli, with the 20-year-old having dramatically exceeded expectations during just his second F1 campaign.
The Brit backed Mercedes' decision following the race in Monza, insisting that Antonelli deserved credit for his performance.
Wolff admitted that "harsh calls" are required to win championships but insisted that there is no "hidden agenda or favouritism" with his team.

"That's been part of our role in the last 12 years, to manage both sides of the garage well," Wolff said. "Because if you are in a title fight, one is always going to be disappointed after a race and the other one is going to be happy.
George Russell explains why the team chose not to pit him during the VSC, which potentially could have cost him the win in Monza.
"I think as long as you're transparent and there is no hidden agenda or favouritism, then it's the best to manage it.

"But it doesn't mean that we are not making some harsh calls. We are having stern talks on a Sunday morning - what are the various situations we are facing? Behind some pressure from another team, and one of our drivers behind the other one and it's too slow, we're going to invert the cars when it's needed.

"But it's a decision that you need to take sometimes, in either direction by the way, whoever is in front. The decisions you need to take in order to win a championship, but it's always going to be balanced."
'We could have looked like idiots, like Ferrari'
Brundle and Rosberg debate who was at fault for the collision between Hamilton-Leclerc.

Ferrari shared the headlines with Antonelli following the Italian Grand Prix after a first-lap incident between Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton, which saw the former push his team-mate into the gravel, resulting in the loss of several places.
Wolff said that the clash made Ferrari look "like idiots" but wanted to avoid being overly critical of his rivals given Antonelli and Russell came close to also leaving Mercedes red-faced.

The Austrian said: "I can express my opinion now and say it's not on to push your team-mate off in Turn 2, but three or four laps from the end, we had some scary moments between the two of them that we didn't expect in that way because George had a tyre that was shot, and Kimi was a second quicker.

"Did we expect them to fight like they did, which could have ended up with a car in the gravel?
"We could have quickly looked like idiots as well, like the Ferraris looked, eventually, so it's a fine margin."

detailZh: 京特·施泰纳表示，基米·安东内利在蒙扎夺冠后“应该效力于法拉利”
京特·施泰纳回顾了积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利在蒙扎的历史性胜利
前哈斯一级方程式车队领队京特·施泰纳认为，梅赛德斯车手、现任积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利在意大利大奖赛上取得令人印象深刻的胜利之后，“应该效力于法拉利”。
安东内利从第19位发车，在蒙扎取得了他职业生涯的第七个大奖赛冠军，并成为60年来首位赢得该赛事的意大利车手。
斯坦纳在参加《红旗播客》节目时，回顾了这位20岁车手的表现。
"法拉利是国家队，所有人都为它加油，而现在这个孩子出现了，之前一直没有意大利车手，"这位前车队领队解释道。"距离上一次有意大利人在蒙扎获胜已经过去60年了。时间太长了，人们都忘了怎么赢。显然，对基米来说，他在梅赛德斯车队这一点不利于他变得受欢迎。
"梅赛德斯是法拉利最大的对手，而他却在那里开车。所以，你仍然希望自己的车队获胜，但另一支车队里的这个孩子是个意大利人。就像在另一支足球队踢球，而且他踢得相当好。
"我认为他值得拥有更多车迷。他所做的事情非常了不起，他应该效力于法拉利。那才是理想的世界。"
安东内利在蒙扎的胜利扩大了他在车手总冠军榜上的领先优势。他目前领先队友拉塞尔66分，拉塞尔暂居积分榜第二。七届总冠军汉密尔顿位列第三，落后拉塞尔10分。
这位意大利车手现在将注意力转向即将在马德里林赛道举行的西班牙大奖赛。他在第二节和第三节自由练习中都做出了最快圈速，并在第一节自由练习中位居第二，仅次于拉塞尔。

detailEn: Kimi Antonelli "should be in a Ferrari" after Monza win, says Guenther Steiner
Guenther Steiner reflects on championship leader Kimi Antonelli's historic victory at Monza

Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner believes Mercedes driver and current championship leader Kimi Antonelli "should be in a Ferrari" following his impressive win at the Italian Grand Prix.
Antonelli secured his seventh career grand prix win at Monza after starting 19th on the grid and became the first Italian driver to win the event in 60 years.
Steiner reflected on the 20-year-old's performance during an appearance on The Red Flags Podcast.

"Ferrari is the national team, and everybody's rooting for it, and now this kid comes along and there was no Italian driver," the former team chief explained. "It's 60 years since the last time an Italian won [at Monza]. It's a long time and you forget how to win. And obviously, for Kimi, being in a Mercedes doesn't help him to get popular.

"Mercedes is the biggest opponent of Ferrari, and he drives there. So, you still hope my team wins, but this kid in that other team is this Italian guy. Plays in another football team and he's pretty good.
"I think he deserves it [more fans]. What he does is extraordinary and he should be in a Ferrari. That would be the ideal world."

Antonelli's win at Monza extended his lead in the drivers' championship. He now sits 66 points ahead of his team-mate George Russell, who is currently second in the standings. Seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton follows in third, 10 points behind Russell.

The Italian driver's focus now shifts to the upcoming Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit. He clocked the fastest times in both the second and third practice sessions and was second-fastest in FP1 behind Russell.
Qualifying for the Spanish Grand Prix will take place at 4pm local time (3pm UK time) on Saturday 12 September.

安东内利最终以0.166秒的优势领先汉密尔顿的法拉利队友夏尔·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在第一次红旗之前以及练习赛恢复之后一直是领跑者，而奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和兰多·诺里斯的迈凯伦赛车也在那段时间提升到了第三和第四名。
但汉密尔顿的撞车是本次练习赛最值得注意的时刻——尽管奥利·比尔曼（Ollie Bearman）在临近结束时引发红旗的撞车是马德里环比赛周末至今最严重的一次。
汉密尔顿刚刚刷出了全场最快的第二计时段（这一成绩直到练习赛结束仍然是最快的），就在第三次自由练习开始23分钟后于最后一个弯角撞车，他锁死了轮胎，车头正面笔直地撞上了泰克普罗（Tecpro）护栏。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿锁死轮胎撞上了护栏！😳
事故经过是这样的……👀 #F1 #西班牙大奖赛
——一级方程式官方账号（@F1），2026年9月12日
他从那里挂上倒挡，尽管法拉利要求他停车，他仍试图把受损的SF-26慢慢开回维修区。
由于前翼剐蹭右前轮并导致轮胎被扎破，汉密尔顿最终把法拉利停在了14号弯——不过这是在他收到比赛工程师卡洛·桑蒂的指令之后才做的："这是正式要求，他们[国际汽联]让我们把车停在尽可能安全的地方。在12号弯[拉·纪念弯]之前靠左停车。"
护栏的维修耗费了大量时间，这促使比赛控制中心采取了暂停计时这一罕见措施，以避免在赛道活动得以恢复之前，练习赛时间就耗尽——而这只是这条赛道举办一级方程式官方行驶的第二天。
三练在红旗出示39分钟后终于恢复，此时剩余时间只有一刻钟。在这段时间里，勒克莱尔提升了自己的最佳成绩，随后安东内利做出了本周末至今的最快圈速：1分32.797秒。
贝尔曼在10号弯撞车，使得排名前列的任何进一步变化戛然而止——该弯道是通往赛道带有倾角的拉·纪念弯的右-左组合弯的第一部分。
贝尔曼看起来并没有碰到墙，而是在弯心失控打滑，赛车被甩得倒着撞上随后左侧弯道外侧的护栏。
赛后他的哈斯车队让他不要担心，并保证会在排位赛前把赛车“重建好”，但赛车左侧遭受的严重损伤表明这远不能保证。
马克斯·维斯塔潘在本次练习中只跑了七圈，却以红牛车手中最好的成绩排名第五，比队友利亚姆·劳森快两个名次、快了超过零点七秒。乔治·拉塞尔则驾驶梅赛德斯第二辆赛车被夹在他们两人中间。
汉密尔顿的成绩仍然足以排在第九，他两侧分别是尼科·霍肯伯格和加布里埃尔·博托莱托的奥迪赛车。
亚历克斯·阿尔本是唯一没有做出圈速的车手。他在倒数第二个弯道出弯时用车身左侧蹭到了护栏，无法重新回到练习中，即使比赛中断了很长时间也没能恢复。

detailEn: Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli headed a final Spanish Grand Prix practice session at the Madring featuring two red flags, including one for a Lewis Hamilton crash at the final corner.

Antonelli ended up 0.166s clear of Hamilton's Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc, the long-time pacesetter before the first red flag and after the session resumed, with the McLarens of Oscar Piastri and Lando Norris improving to third and fourth in that period too.
But Hamilton's crash was the session's most noteworthy moment - even if Ollie Bearman's late red-flag inducing crash was the biggest of the Madring weekend yet.

Hamilton had just set the fastest middle sector of all (which still stood as the fastest at the end of the session) when he crashed at the final corner 23 minutes into FP3, locking up and heading nose-first, square-on into the Tecpro barrier.
Lewis Hamilton locks up and hits the barrier! 😳
Here is how the incident unfolded... 👀#F1 #SpanishGP pic.twitter.com/YDTN59NAlC
— Formula 1 (@F1) September 12, 2026
He found reverse gear from there and, despite protestations from Ferrari to stop the car, attempted to limp his SF-26 back to the pits.

With the front wing rubbing against the front-right tyre, which became punctured, Hamilton did eventually park the Ferrari at Turn 14 - though only after he was told by race engineer Carlo Santi: "It's a formal request, they [the FIA] told us to stop in the safest place possible. Stop before Turn 12 [La Monumental], on the left."

Repairs to the barrier took a significant amount of time, which prompted race control to take the unusual step of pausing the clock to prevent the session time from elapsing before track activity could continue on what is only the second day of official F1 running at the track.

FP3 did finally resume 39 minutes after the red flag was shown with a quarter of an hour left on the clock, a period in which Leclerc improved his best time before Antonelli set the fastest lap of the weekend so far, a 1m32.797s.
Any further changes to the head of the order were prevented by Bearman's crash, which came at Turn 10, the first part of a right-left leading into the circuit's banked La Monumental corner.
Bearman did not appear to clip the wall but lost the car at the apex and spun, which pitched his car backwards into the barrier on the outside of the subsequent left-hand bend.

He was assured by his Haas team afterwards not to worry and that the team would "get it rebuilt" before qualifying, but significant damage to the left-hand side of his car suggested that is far from guaranteed.

Max Verstappen completed just seven laps in the session but ended up fifth-fastest in the best of the Red Bulls, two places but more than seven tenths faster than team-mate Liam Lawson. George Russell was sandwiched between them in the second of the Mercedes cars.
Hamilton's time was still good enough for ninth, with the Audis of Nico Hulkenberg and Gabriel Bortoleto either side of him.

Alex Albon was the only driver not to set a time. He glanced the barrier with the left-hand side of his car exiting the penultimate corner and could not rejoin the session, even after the long pause in proceedings.

detailZh: 安东尼·戴维森警告年轻车手不要效仿刘易斯·汉密尔顿在马德里FP3的行为
安东尼·戴维森批评刘易斯·汉密尔顿在马德里FP3中继续驾驶受损法拉利赛车
前一级方程式车手、天空体育评论员安东尼·戴维森认为，刘易斯·汉密尔顿在马德里第三节练习赛中为年轻车手树立了不良榜样。
汉密尔顿在FP3最后一个弯道撞车，引发红旗。他设法倒车离开护墙，并在轮胎爆胎、前翼卡在车底的情况下继续行驶。
“车队需要给他更多信息，”戴维森在天空体育直播中解释道，当时这位英国人仍在驾驶受损赛车。
“他们需要告诉他前翼在你车底，赛事总监会因此给我们处罚。”
尽管赛事工程师多次指示他在安全地点停车，汉密尔顿仍试图将赛车开回维修区。当被告知他收到了赛事总监的直接指令后，他最终在14号弯出口停车。
戴维森补充说，汉密尔顿的决定可能为年轻车手树立不良榜样。“任何现在正在观看的年轻车手，你不能那样做。你就是不能那样做，”他说。
“那可能是你试图做的[回到维修区]，但那条规则的存在是有原因的。如果前翼完全卡到车底，把你的前轮顶起来，而赛道上还有马歇尔，你必须考虑所有这些情况。”
练习赛恢复后，梅赛德斯的基米·安东内利做出最快圈速，汉密尔顿排名第九。截至发稿时，国际汽联尚未就这位七届世界冠军可能面临的处罚发布更新。预计他可能面临罚款或竞技处罚。
detailEn: Anthony Davidson warns young drivers not to follow Lewis Hamilton's Madrid FP3 example
Anthony Davidson criticised Lewis Hamilton for continuing to drive his damaged Ferrari during Madrid FP3
Former Formula 1 driver and Sky Sports analyst Anthony Davidson has argued that Lewis Hamilton set a bad example for junior drivers during the third practice session in Madrid.
Hamilton crashed at the final corner during FP3, bringing out the red flag. He managed to reverse away from the wall and resume driving with a puncture and the front wing under the car.
"The team need to give him more information," Davidson explained on the Sky Sports broadcast as the Briton continued to drive the damaged car.
"They need to say the front wing is under your car and the race director is going to give us a penalty over this."

Despite receiving repeated instructions from his race engineer to stop the car in a safe place, Hamilton attempted to nurse the car back to the pits. He eventually pulled over and stopped the car at the exit of Turn 14 when he was informed he had received direct instructions from the race director.
Davidson added that the decision from Hamilton could set a poor example for young drivers. "Any young driver that is watching this right now, you don't do that. You just don't do that," he said.

"That's what you could have tried to do [get back to the pits] but that rule is there for a reason. If it went under the car completely and jacked your front wheels up and there were marshals on the track, you've got to think of all these scenarios."

The session resumed, with Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli going on to set the fastest lap, and Hamilton was ninth. At the time of writing, there has yet to be an update from the FIA regarding a potential penalty for the seven-time champion. It is anticipated that he could face either a fine or a sporting penalty.

items.summaryEn: Championship leader Kimi Antonelli set the fastest time in a red-flagged third practice session for the Spanish Grand Prix at the Madring circuit. The session was interrupted twice by crashes involving Lewis Hamilton and Oliver Bearman.
detailZh: F1西班牙大奖赛：安东内利在红旗中断的FP3中居首，此前汉密尔顿和贝尔曼发生撞车
在F1西班牙大奖赛的最后一节练习中，安东内利力压查尔斯·勒克莱尔，而刘易斯·汉密尔顿引发了一次长时间的红旗。
积分榜领先者基米·安东内利在西班牙大奖赛充满挑战的马德里赛道进入排位赛前，做出了最快圈速，此前最后一节F1练习赛因两次撞车而受损。
在马德里练习赛中途长时间中断后，安东内利顶住了法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔的冲击，重新夺回首位。
FP3在进行到23分钟时暂停，当时法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿在第22号弯、即最后一个弯道锁死前轮，直接撞上护墙，前翼脱落。
汉密尔顿与TecPro护墙的碰撞本应相对无害，但如果不是他刚刚经过维修区入口，他就不得不尝试用三个轮子完成一整圈，因为他的前翼拖在地上，并开始刺穿右前轮胎。与车队指令相反，这位七届世界冠军试图在红旗状态下坚持绕行，直到他在第14号弯出口处中途放弃。
随后的护墙修复耗时过长，赛事控制决定在15分38秒时停表，以确保车手们仍有合理的时间恢复练习。
在那个阶段，汉密尔顿的队友勒克莱尔拥有最快圈速，1分33秒332，超过了安东内利此前1分33秒664的基准，而汉密尔顿位列第四，落后于世界冠军兰多·诺里斯。
在赛道工作人员重新对齐护墙、延迟近40分钟后，练习重新开始，为排位赛前微调赛车调校提供了最后机会。
勒克莱尔是第一个开始飞驰圈的前排车手，将自己此前的基准提升至1分32秒963。这最初比梅赛德斯所能拿出的更快，安东内利落后0.3秒，仅领先奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。
但在第二次尝试中，安东内利找到了大量圈速，以1分32秒797的成绩接管领先。
安东内利的成绩没有受到威胁，因为哈斯车手奥利弗·贝尔曼的撞车引发了第二次红旗。在练习赛最后一分钟，贝尔曼在第10号右弯失去车尾，撞上混凝土墙，赛车左侧严重受损。贝尔曼撞上混凝土墙实际上巩固了安东内利领先勒克莱尔的地位。
在周五落后更多之后，迈凯伦似乎谨慎地向前迈出了一步，皮亚斯特里和诺里斯锁定第三和第四，仅落后安东内利0.2秒。
马克斯·维斯塔潘在汉密尔顿引发红旗前才加入练习，起步较晚。这位荷兰人位列第五，落后0.375秒，红牛在马德里赛道的路肩上继续挣扎，整体表现不如对手。
奥利弗·贝尔曼提前结束了练习
拉塞尔不得不放弃红旗前那次做出最快第一赛段成绩的飞驰圈，停赛后也未能拼凑出一个有代表性的圈速，仅列第六，之后是红牛二队的利亚姆·劳森，他在最后一次飞驰圈中犯错。
尼科·霍肯伯格在奥迪车队位列第九，此前他出人意料地做出最快第一赛段，但随后在圈中后段被交通阻挡。汉密尔顿最终跌至第九，霍肯伯格的队友加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托跻身前十。
威廉姆斯车手亚历克斯·阿尔本的练习提前结束，他在练习开始时撞墙，随后消失在车库中进行悬挂维修。
detailEn: F1 Spanish GP: Kimi Antonelli tops red-flagged FP3 following Lewis Hamilton, Oliver Bearman crashes
Antonelli pips Charles Leclerc in final practice at Formula 1's Spanish Grand Prix as Lewis Hamilton caused a lengthy red flag

Championship leader Kimi Antonelli heads into qualifying at the Spanish Grand Prix's challenging Madring circuit with the fastest time, following a final Formula 1 practice session marred by two crashes.
Antonelli fended off advances by Ferrari's Charles Leclerc to reclaim top spot after a lengthy stoppage during the middle of the practice session in Madrid.
FP3 was halted after 23 minutes when Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton locked up his front tyres into Turn 22, the final corner, bumping straight into the wall and dislocating his front wing.

Hamilton's tap with the TecPro wall would have been relatively innocuous if he hadn't just passed pit entry, and thus had to try and complete a full lap of the circuit on three wheels as his wing dragged on the ground and started piercing the front-right tyre. Contrary to his team's instructions, the seven-time world champion attempted to make it round under the red flag until he had to abandon his effort midway through at the exit of Turn 14.

The barrier repairs that followed took so long that race control decided to stop the clock at 15m38, ensuring that there would still be a reasonable amount of time left for drivers to resume practice.

At that stage, Hamilton's team-mate Leclerc had the fastest time to his name, a 1m33.332 that beat Antonelli's earlier benchmark of 1m33.664s, while Hamilton was fourth behind world champion Lando Norris.
After an extended delay of nearly 40 minutes as track workers realigned the barriers, action got under way for a last chance to fine tune cars set-ups ahead of qualifying.

Leclerc was the first frontrunner to embark on a hot lap, lowering his own benchmark to a 1m32.963s. That was initially faster than what Mercedes had in the tank, with Antonelli conceding three tenths, narrowly ahead of Oscar Piastri.
But on his second attempt Antonelli found a chunk of lap time to take over the lead with a 1m32.797s effort.

Antonelli's time didn't come under threat, due to a late second red flag for a crash by Haas driver Oliver Bearman. In the final minute of the session, Bearman lost the rear of his car into the Turn 10 right-hander, smacking into the concrete wall and sustaining significant damage to his car's left-hand side. Bearman's crash into the concrete effectively cemented Antonelli's lead ahead of Leclerc.
After having been farther adrift on Friday, McLaren appeared to have taken a tentative step forward as Piastri and Norris sealed third and fourth, just two tenths behind Antonelli.

Max Verstappen made a delayed start after only joining the action right before Hamilton's red flag. The Dutchman was fifth, 0.375s behind, as Red Bull continued to struggle over the Madring circuit's kerbs and generally lacked performance compared to its rivals.
Oliver Bearman brought practice to an early end

Russell, who had to abort his pre-red flag flyer that yielded the fastest first sector time, didn't piece together a representative lap after the stoppage either and only managed sixth, followed by the second Red Bull of Liam Lawson who made a mistake on his final flyer.

Nico Hulkenberg was ninth in the Audi after surprisingly setting the fastest first sector, only to be blocked by traffic later on in the lap. Hamilton dropped down to ninth by the end, with Hulkenberg's team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto rounding out the top 10.
The session ended early for Williams man Alex Albon, who tapped the wall at the start of the session and disappeared into the garage for suspension repairs.
keyPointsZh: 汉密尔顿在第22号弯锁死前轮撞墙，前翼脱落，随后在红旗状态下坚持行驶，直到第14号弯出口处才停下。
贝尔曼在练习赛最后一分钟于第10号弯失控撞墙，导致第二次红旗，比赛提前结束。
勒克莱尔一度以1分32秒963领先，但安东内利随后以1分32秒797夺回首位；皮亚斯特里和诺里斯分列第三、第四。
keyPointsEn: Hamilton locked up his front tyres into Turn 22 and hit the wall, dislocating his front wing, then attempted to continue under the red flag until he stopped at the exit of Turn 14.
Bearman lost the rear of his car into the Turn 10 right-hander in the final minute of the session, causing a second red flag that ended practice early.
Leclerc initially led with a 1m32.963s, but Antonelli reclaimed top spot with a 1m32.797s; Piastri and Norris were third and fourth.

Lewis Hamilton crashes in final practice at the Spanish Grand Prix as Kimi Antonelli tops the session; watch Spanish GP Qualifying from the all-new Madring circuit live on Sky Sports F1 at 3pm on Saturday, and the race at 2pm on Sunday
Lewis Hamilton found the barrier during third practice and then ignored team orders to stop as he tried to make his way back to the pits
Championship leader Kimi Antonelli was fastest in final practice at the Spanish Grand Prix as Lewis Hamilton crashed and lost valuable track time ahead of qualifying in Madrid.
Just 20 minutes into the session, Hamilton was on course to set a very quick lap until he outbraked himself at the last corner and hit the barriers head-on, albeit at a relatively slow speed.
He reversed out of the barriers but the front wing had dislodged itself and got stuck under the front right tyre, so Ferrari urged Hamilton to stop the car.

Sky Sports F1's Anthony Davidson feels Hamilton was wrong to drive for such a long time with a damaged car.

"Any young driver that is watching this right now, you don't do that. You just don't do that. That's what you could have tried to do [get back to the pits] but that rule is there for a reason," he said.
"If it [the front wing] went under the car completely and jacked your front wheels up and there were marshals on the track... you've got to think of all these scenarios."

这位法拉利车手的练习赛戛然而止：他在马德里赛道最后一个弯角撞上护墙，导致右前轮爆胎且前翼受损破裂

“耶啊啊啊他肯定要吃罚单了，哈哈，”一位车迷在Reddit上评论道，预测这位英国车手将受到处罚。

detailEn: Lewis Hamilton under fire after ignoring Ferrari calls to stop damaged car in Madrid FP3
Lewis Hamilton faced criticism from fans after ignoring Ferrari’s calls to stop his damaged car during third practice for the Spanish GP
Seven-time Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton has come under fire from fans after ignoring orders to stop his damaged Ferrari during the third free practice session in Madrid.
The Ferrari driver's session ended abruptly when he hit the wall at the final corner of the Madring circuit, sustaining a front-right puncture and a broken front wing.

Rather than stopping on the side of the track, Hamilton attempted to nurse his machinery back to the pitlane. The decision left a trail of debris and led to a tense radio exchange with his race engineer Carlo Santi, who repeatedly urged Hamilton to pull over in a safe place.
Hamilton did eventually stop on the side of the track at the exit of Turn 14, and fans have already had a lot to say about the incident.
"Yeaaaahhhh he’s getting that penalty lol," one fan commented on Reddit, predicting a penalty for the Briton.

"Lewis, when you get told to stop the car, just stop the car. Way too risky for penalties lol," someone else posted, and another fan added: "Doing all that just to stop before the pits anyway is not Lewis’ proudest moment I can’t lie."

Others were more forgiving about the moment. "This put everything into context quite well. Everyone just trying to do the best thing possible," another fan wrote in response to the team radio messages.
"He's dropping that extra rubber on track which will help him in qualifying," someone else added.
